svg.title: Spring Boot Microservices — Full Architecture with Zipkin and CI/CD
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing microservices with distributed tracing via Zipkin and CI/CD pipeline through GitHub, Jenkins, Docker, and GKE.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Client do in this architecture?')
sendPrompt('How does Auth0 JWT validation work with Spring Cloud Gateway?')
sendPrompt('What does Spring Cloud Gateway do?')
sendPrompt('How does the Redis-backed rate limiter work?')
sendPrompt('Why is Redis used for the rate limiter?')
sendPrompt('How does Eureka Service Registry enable service discovery?')
sendPrompt('How does Zipkin distributed tracing work with Spring Boot microservices?')
sendPrompt('How does ProductService implement the cache-aside pattern?')
sendPrompt('What does UserService do?')
sendPrompt('How does OrderService use Feign Client to call PaymentService?')
sendPrompt('What does PaymentService do?')
sendPrompt('What is stored in ProductDB?')
sendPrompt('What is stored in OrderDB?')
sendPrompt('What is stored in PaymentDB?')
sendPrompt('How does ConfigServer pull config from GitHub?')
sendPrompt('What triggers the CI/CD pipeline in this architecture?')
sendPrompt('What does Jenkins do in this CI/CD pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How is Docker used in this CI/CD pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What role does the Docker registry play?')
sendPrompt('How does GKE deploy microservices from the Docker registry?')
